title: fake-llm scenario
description:
One named behaviour: an ordered list of steps. After a load or reset, call N gets step N.
A call after the last step gets `NoMoreStepsError`.

$schema.description:
The scenario JSON Schema's URL or path, for editors (see `schema/scenario.schema.json`).
Ignored by the server. Only at the top level, not in a step.

Step.description:
One scripted reply: a reply (`text`, `toolCalls` or both, optionally with `thinking` and
`usage`), or a scripted `error`. A step sets exactly one of a reply and `error`.

thinking.description: An Anthropic thinking block, or an OpenAI Responses `reasoning` output item (`rs_fake_<n>`, one `summary_text` part), before the text and tool calls. Only on a reply step. Ignored by OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini.

stopReason.description:
The `stop_reason` of a reply; `max_tokens` reports a truncated reply. On a step with
`toolCalls` it must be `end_turn` or `tool_use`, and every format with a stop reason
reports a tool-call stop; an OpenAI Responses reply with tool calls is `completed`.
`max_tokens` is an `incomplete` OpenAI Responses reply (`max_output_tokens`).

streamChunkChars.description:
Size of each streamed delta, in Unicode code points (Anthropic, OpenAI Chat Completions and
Responses, and Gemini streams).

streamInterChunkDelayMs.description:
Milliseconds to wait before each streamed delta (Anthropic, OpenAI Chat Completions and
Responses, and Gemini streams; a Gemini functionCall chunk has no wait). At most 600000
(10 minutes).

streamErrorAfterChunks.description:
Only on an error step, and only when streamed (Anthropic, OpenAI Chat Completions and
Responses, and Gemini): send this many text deltas, then an in-stream error.

firstByteDelayMs.description:
Milliseconds to wait before any response bytes, status and headers included (every
generation route; buffered and streamed replies and error steps). The call is numbered
and logged when it arrives, before the wait. At most 600000 (10 minutes).

toolCalls.description: Tool calls the reply makes, in order, after any `text`.

usage.description:
The token counts this reply reports. Only on a reply step. Unset counts keep the
defaults (100 input, 50 output); totals are the sum; the Anthropic cache figures don't
change.

ErrorStep.description: A scripted HTTP error in place of a reply.

body.description: The response body, sent as given.

headers.description: Extra response headers, such as `retry-after`, sent as given.

name.description: The tool's name, sent as given.

arguments.description: The arguments as a JSON object. With `rawArguments` also unset, `{}`.

rawArguments.description:
The argument text, sent verbatim: invalid JSON is allowed. Only the OpenAI formats (Chat
Completions and Responses) and a streamed Anthropic reply carry it; a buffered Anthropic or a Gemini request whose next step
has it gets `ExceptionError`, and the step is not used.

id.description:
The call's id. Default: `toolu_fake_<seq>_<n>` (Anthropic) and `call_fake_<seq>_<n>`
(OpenAI; the `call_id` on Responses), where `n` is the call's 1-based position in the step. Gemini sends an id only when
one is set.

TokenUsage.description: Token counts a reply step reports in every vendor's usage fields.
